mentions.name: WebVetted
mentions.description: A vetting tool for Facebook Marketplace sellers: you enter a name and it assembles an OSINT-style report on any Facebook user, letting sellers vet buyers before meeting them in person. It is early stage but reportedly works well.
mentions.problem: Sellers on Facebook Marketplace lack a way to vet buyers before meeting them in real life.
mentions.source_excerpt: A vetting tool for sellers on Fabebook Marketplace (which we all love to hate) to vet Buyers before they meet them irl. check it > https://webvetted.com/detect/social/facebook
